ItemID: NA; Title: Crossfade; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its melodic hard rock fits my interest in One Day Remains and Seventeen Days; I would choose it now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Once More 'Round the Sun; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its heavy, progressive sound appeals to the side of my taste reflected in 10.000 Days; I would try it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mutter; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy riffs appeal, but I am more interested in the other choices this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Stadium Arcadium; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for heavier music right now, so its funk rock direction is less appealing today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its aggressive vocals and rhythmic shifts fit my current interest in heavy, adventurous rock; I would choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fury of Our Maker's Hand       explicit_lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its forceful grooves fit my interest in heavy albums such as Advance And Vanquish and Soundtrack to Your Escape; I would try it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Awake       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Assuming this is Godsmack's album, its heavy grooves appeal, but I would leave it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Worship Music; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The thrash sound fits my heavier interests, but it is a lower priority than today's selections.
ItemID: NA; Title: See You On The Other Side       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy, melodic sound could suit my interest in Ten Thousand Fists, but I would postpone it today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Scream; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not identify the album clearly enough for me to choose it confidently.
